name: Product rows
description: Products in a list with a thumbnail; tap to see options.
source:
Component(
  dsl: 1, id: "market/product-rows", name: "Product rows", kind: Kind.productCollection,
  description: "Products in a list with a thumbnail; tap to see options.",
  variants: [Variant(id: "default", label: "Default", build:
    Column(gap: Space.sm, children: [ForEach(items: options.products, as: "p", child: Box(padding: Space.sm, radius: Radius.md, background: Color.surface, border: Border(width: 1), onTap: OpenProduct(product: p), ariaLabel: p.name, child: Row(gap: Space.md, crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center, children: [
      Image(src: p.image_url, alt: p.name, width: 64, height: 64, radius: Radius.md, fit: Fit.cover),
      Expanded(child: Column(gap: Space.xs, children: [Text(child: p.name, weight: FontWeight.semibold), Text(child: formatMoney(p.display_price_cents), color: Color.textMuted)])),
      Icon(name: Icons.chevronRight, color: Color.textMuted)
    ])))])
  )], options: [DataOption(name: "products", type: Product, list: true, required: true)],
)
